landing.title: vibe-gambling — every prompt is a spin
landing.description: A PS1-style roulette that pops up every time you ask Claude Code for something. The most honest casino on the internet: you win nothing, you lose nothing, and you still can't stop. Global leaderboard of the most broke devs.
landing.kicker: A PLUGIN FOR CLAUDE CODE · $0, 100% DOPAMINE
landing.lede: Send a prompt, Claude starts thinking, and instead of waiting like a normal person, you bet. The ball drops when the answer lands. You were going to stare at the screen anyway; now you can at least lose coins that don't exist.
landing.then: Then run /vibe-login and send any prompt. The house always wins; your code sometimes compiles.
landing.demo: Free demo (the first one always is)
landing.how.title: HOW IT WORKS
landing.how.1: Every prompt opens a round. The wheel spins while Claude works. You don't; that's what you're paying for.
landing.how.2: Bet with the mouse, a keyboard like a gamepad, or /bet, without leaving the terminal or the spiral.
landing.how.3: Broke? Ludo-Credit Express lends you more at {apr}% APR, no questions asked, no collateral. Monthly seasons, eternal shame.
landing.lb.empty: Nobody has gone broke this season yet. Enjoy this moment of peace.
landing.lb.error: The leaderboard is unavailable right now. Not even the house knows how much you owe.
landing.lb.newAccounts: GitHub accounts younger than {days} days can play, but only show up here and in the Hall of Ruin once they turn {days} days old. Farming accounts to flex your ruin is not worth it.
landing.hall.title: HALL OF RUIN
landing.hall.lede: The most broke devs of every closed season, forever. Like a museum, but sadder.
landing.hall.empty: No season has closed yet. History is still being lost.
